decisions.rationale: The 2025 NOA shows $117,225 and the pay stub (base plus commission) annualizes to $118,500, with 2024 NOA showing a similar commission history.
Chequing balance of $219,676 with about 3 months of history and only payroll deposits comfortably covers the $188,800 down payment and closing costs.
Rive-Nord Evaluations (on panel) valued the property at $758,000 against a $755,000 price in a report dated 2026-05-23.
GDS is about 33.3% and TDS about 41.6% using the bureau-reported payments, under the 39% and 44% limits, with a 664 credit score.
